question.problem: Find the characteristic equation of the matrix $L=[\begin{aligned}0 & 0 \\ -1 & \frac{1}{5}\end{aligned}].$
question.worked_solution:
First, we find the matrix $\,L-\lambda I:$
﻿﻿﻿

$$
L-\lambda I=[\begin{aligned}0-\lambda  & 0 \\ -1 & \frac{1}{5}-\lambda \end{aligned}].
$$

Then, the characteristic equation is

$$
\begin{aligned}det(L-\lambda I) & =0 \\ |\begin{aligned}-\lambda  & 0 \\ -1 & \frac{1}{5}-\lambda \end{aligned}| & =0 \\ -\lambda (\frac{1}{5}-\lambda )-(-1)\cdot 0 & =0 \\ -\frac{1}{5}\lambda +{\lambda }^{2} & =0 \\ {\lambda }^{2}-\frac{1}{5}\lambda  & =0.\end{aligned}
$$
